The '''C.R.A.S.H. Rookies''' are minor characters in {{SA}}.

==History==
===Background===
The two unnamed corrupt cops are enlisted by [[Frank Tenpenny]] to join the [[C.R.A.S.H.]] during the [[Los Santos Riots]] in [[1992]] to replace the two [[High Noon|deceased]] C.R.A.S.H. members [[Eddie Pulaski]] and [[Jimmy Hernandez]].

===Events of ''Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas''===
After [[Carl Johnson]] escapes [[Big Smoke]]'s burning [[Big Smoke's Crack Palace|crack palace]] building, Tenpenny attempts to drive away in his [[Fire Truck (ladder)|Fire Truck]] with the two rookies inside, but [[Sweet Johnson]] jumps on his [[Greenwood (3D Universe)|Greenwood]] and then leaps at the ladder on the back of the truck, and hangs on from it. Carl enters a parked [[Feltzer]] and starts to chase Tenpenny. 

During the chase, one of the rookies in the truck gets out and starts stomping on Sweet's fingers. Carl gets the Feltzer under the ladder and Sweet drops onto the hood and then climbs over into the passenger seat. After that, the second rookie armed with a [[Micro SMG (3D Universe)|Micro SMG]] gets out of the truck cabin to help the other rookie at the back of the truck. Both of them are ultimately killed by Carl during the chase.

==Character==
===Appearance===
The rookies use generic [[Los Santos Police Department (3D Universe)|LSPD]] police officer models.

==Prominent Appearances in Gameplay==
*[[End of the Line]] <small>(Killed)</small>
